description: Install or update ADP config, capability help, output directories, installed resources, and safe legacy cleanup.
outputs: config.yaml, config.user.yaml, and module-help.csv; skill/schema/template/catalog and ELK version/license/checksum inspection; reported migration needs

description: Initialize or upgrade shared ADP memory without overwriting existing project facts.
outputs: ADP memory scaffold, cadence, schemas, baseline intake, program-status/flow-graph/management-panel snapshot directories, empty panel view directory, and starter views; never placeholder panel or graph artifacts

description: Propose and validate candidates, preview-token-protect approved revisions, and inspect or audit-recover orphan baseline locks.
outputs: program baseline and revision history; lock owner disposition and immutable recovery receipt; validation findings and preview diff

description: Create or normalize a Workstream Delivery Record with evidence, decision, readiness, and review-plan artifacts.
outputs: new WDR with evidence.md, decisions.md, and readiness.md; or a non-destructive registration patch plan

description: Discover, confirm, and sync BMM/TEA lifecycle checkpoints without duplicating delivery artifacts.
args: {discover <project root> --workstream-id <id> --checkpoint <name> --artifact <key=path-or-url>}|{confirm <project root> --candidate-id <id> --decision confirm|dismiss --confirmed-by <owner>}|{sync <project root> --candidate-id <id>}|{packet-sync <project root> <packet options>}|{--dry-run}
outputs: checkpoint candidates, confirmations, previews, WDR updates, and optional status-sync intake

description: Close meeting, offline, chat, or DingTalk evidence into replay-safe archives and owned ADP updates.
outputs: meeting archive and lineage receipt, daily/decision/WDR writes, Business Decision Packets, gap/action-quality audit, and status-sync intake

description: Apply owner status, baseline-mapped milestone actuals and forecasts, staleness checks, and action-ledger upserts.
outputs: WDR status and roadmap updates, daily logs, action-ledger upserts, canonical action-flow relation view, and reported stale follow-up candidates

description: Review cross-workstream risks, dependencies, blockers, and changes, producing traceable views and decision packets.
outputs: risk matrix, dependency map, canonical risk-flow relation view, and Business Decision Packets

description: Index L0 artifacts and extract project gates, contracts, NFRs, evidence rules, impacts, and open questions.
outputs: persisted L0 summaries and extracted constraints; reported WDR gap suggestions

description: Evaluate acceptance and cutover readiness from source evidence, confirmations, decisions, and L0 constraints.
outputs: localized readiness Markdown and HTML, scorecards, and optional generated workstream readiness blocks

description: Audit input facts or validate generated artifacts for completeness, consistency, freshness, lineage, and rendering safety.
outputs: input, artifact, flow-graph, and management-panel validation gates at the default immutable audit root

description: Generate or inspect the canonical overall project status, confidence, progress, dual-axis flow state, immutable snapshot, and period delta.
outputs: immutable program-status snapshot, canonical progress and flow-state JSON, localized status, weekly report, and project-lead views

description: Render the baseline-aware planned, forecast, actual, variance, revision, and unmapped roadmap views.
outputs: roadmap JSON and localized Markdown with baseline/status lineage; scoped runs use views/roadmaps/<scope>

description: Generate the canonical baseline topology, dual-axis state, scoped overlays, unmapped records, and layered graph identities.
outputs: canonical views/flow-graph.json plus immutable and latest snapshots/flow-graph JSON with topology/state/overlay identities

description: Render audience-specific FDE morning or business biweekly packs from canonical status and audited facts.
outputs: localized meeting pack Markdown, JSON distillate with canonical flow selection, omissions appendix, and write-back lineage at the default pack root

description: Build or inspect a self-contained audited management panel and create explicit immutable distribution archives.
outputs: atomic current index.html, immutable panel bundle JSON, and optional immutable internal-full or shareable-summary HTML archive

description: Explain canonical ADP status, lineage-validates canonical management Markdown, and route every durable change to its owner; legacy renderer-only flags return ADP-PL-LEGACY-RENDERER-MIGRATION-REQUIRED.
outputs: lineage-validated conversational Markdown or JSON readout, panel refresh/open/archive routing, source-backed summaries, deterministic legacy migration error, and owning-workflow routing
